article_content: CNN -- Cornwall, England's rugged southwestern peninsula tumbling into the Atlantic, feels primed for ghost stories. Its isolation deepened after 2023 storms severed rail links, sparking emergency repairs. During my visit, I journey with Catharine Amy Dawson Scott's spirit - a late-Victorian writer famous for spooky tales like *The Haunting* and her 1911 guidebook *Nooks and Corners of Cornwall*. Traveling by the historic Night Riviera Sleeper train from London, I explore her former home Wastehills, now an eco-friendly retreat owned by Ben's family. Stops include luxury hotels like The Scarlet overlooking Mawgan Porth's surfing beaches, and Constantine Bay favored by Margaret Thatcher. In Padstow, Rick Stein's restaurants showcase Cornish cuisine blending 'bitter and sweet' flavors mirroring Dawson Scott's writing. Her assertion that Cornwall 'must be revisited until it becomes your own' resonates deeply.

Pēc 2023. gada vētras, kas nometa vienīgo vilciena savienojumu, tā izolācija kļuva vēl lielāka, izraisot uzticami atjaunošanas pasākumus. Ceļojot no Londras ar vēsturiska Naktīšanas Rivieras Vagonu, es ceļoju kopā ar Kate-rinu Disona Skotta vēsturētojas - viktoriaņu laika rakstniece, autore populāra pildspoku romāna *The Haunting*, un tās 1911. gada vadlīdzības grāmatas. Mans ceļojums ietver apmeklēšanu tās iepriekšējā mājā Wastehills, tagad dzīvokli, ko nodrošina Bena ģimene. Luxusa hupe The Scarlet atrodas virs Mawgan Porth surfpludmalas, bet Konstantīnas pludmale, ko mīlēja Marģārete Teta, atgādina par vēsturisko īpašību. Pādsto apmetnē Riksta Staina restorāni piedāvā Kornvaldas ēdienu kombinecijas, kas savieno 'skāru un slodu', tāpat kā Disona Skotta stilis. Viņas doma, ka Kornvalda 'jāatrodas līdz tā kļūst jūsu tēvzeme', paliek garīgā.

article_content: CHARLESTON, South Carolina (CNN) — Magoline Hazelton is used to people driving by her home just to take a look. Known locally as the 'house lady,' she lives in a residence constructed from steel shipping containers. While her home appears similar to neighbors', its construction method differs dramatically. Container-based housing has surged in popularity due to lower costs and faster assembly than conventional builds. With over 18 million containers globally transporting goods annually, surplus units often accumulate at U.S. ports. SG Blocks, founded by David Cross and Steve Armstrong, specializes in repurposing these containers. Cross noted their maritime-inspired design inspiration and structural durability, enabling multifamily living spaces. Modifications require 95% less energy than melting scrap steel (saving 8,600 kWh per container). Single-family container homes match traditional costs but offer superior durability, while multi-unit projects cost 10–15% less. The modular design allows customization for aesthetics while maintaining weather resistance and low maintenance needs. Hazelton's five-year experience confirms minimal upkeep beyond routine systems replacement.

Konteineru izmantošana mājām būvēšanai pēdējos gados ir kļuvusi par modeļu, jo tas var būt īpaši ekonomisks un ātrs risinājums salīdzinājumā ar tradicionālajām metodēm. Saziņas direktors Dāvids Kross agrāk strādāja kā kuģa darbinieks un daudz laika pavadīja piekuļu vidē, strādādams ar konteineriem. 'Kad skatāties uz kuģa dekla, redzams simtiem līdz tūkstošiem konteineriem, kas perfekti ievietoti,' Kross teica. 'Viņi tika sagremoti deviņos līnijos zem dekla, piecus vai sešus virs dekla, un es tikai turpināju redzēt viesnīcas virs dekla mūsu kuģa.'

article_content: Paris Saint-Germain striker Edinson Cavani is set to reject advances from Manchester United following the club's failure to qualify for next season's Champions League, according to reports. The 26-year-old has been linked with a move to Old Trafford, but French publication L'Equipe states United's absence from European competition means the forward prefers to remain in Paris. The paper also claims Cavani was unhappy with his position in the PSG team, but following discussions with the club, he has decided to stay at Parc des Princes. The Uruguay international joined PSG for £55 million on a five-year deal from Napoli in July 2013. He scored 22 goals in 39 appearances to help secure a Ligue 1 and Coupe de France double, despite often playing out wide to accommodate Zlatan Ibrahimovic's central role. United's attacking options include Robin van Persie, Wayne Rooney, Javier Hernández, and Danny Welbeck. Cavani could attract further interest during the 2014 World Cup, particularly when facing England on June 19.

article_content: Jeff and Shaleia Ayan, co-founders of Twin Flames Universe (TFU)—a spiritual movement positioning itself as therapeutic—reject cult accusations. Former participants dispute this claim. Investigative journalist Alice Hines' 2020 Vanity Fair article inspired *Desperately Seeking Soulmate*, a Prime Video documentary examining TFU's operations. Hines defines their core belief: 'Twin flames are eternal soulmates connected across lifetimes.' Originating from Jeff and Shaleia's 2012 relationship, TFU evolved into a Hawaii-based enterprise offering paid programs like the Twin Flame Ascension School. Its flagship 'Mirror Exercise' assigns personal responsibility by restructuring blame narratives. Coaches earn commissions but must recruit new members, requiring $3,000+ investments in course materials. Financial coercion is exemplified by 18-year-old Kay's account of being urged to obtain a credit card for subscriptions. TFU enforces rigid gender roles ('divine masculine/feminine') and pressures members to question their sexual orientation/gender identity, drawing condemnation from scholars. Despite a 2020 Vanity Fair exposé prompting some departures, the community's Facebook group grew from 14,000 to over 40,000 members by 2023.

Priekšiešie dalībnieki atšķiras ar savu viedokli. Pētījošā žurnāliste Alicijas Hīn izpildītā 2020. gada Vanity Fair raksts ieguva pamatu dokumentālajai seriju *Desperately Seeking Soulmate*, ko redzams Amazon Prime Video. TFU sākās ar Jefa un Šeļejas saikni 2012. gadā, un tagad to vadītāji piedāvā maksas programmās, piemēram, Twin Flame Ascension Skolu. Finansiāla spiediena piemērs ir 18 gadus vecās Kay stāsts par kredītkarti prasību abonementam. TFU ievieš seksuālo attiecību normas ('dīvīns maskulīns/femīna') un piespied pieņemt seksuālo orientāciju apspriedi, kas novērsa vēsturnieku kritiku. Neraugoties uz 2020. gada skandālu, TFU grupas sociālajos medijos līdz 2023. gadam pieauga no 14 000 līdz 40 000 dalībniekiem.

article_content: Researchers from Monash University Malaysia's Business School caution that cultural son preference may intensify gender disparities in aging Asian societies. Their study 'Happiness in Old Age: The Daughter Connection,' published in the Journal of Happiness Studies, reveals that while sons are traditionally favored, elderly individuals experience greater well-being when living with daughters. By 2030, Asia will hold the world's largest elderly population, yet aging women face systemic neglect as burdens in patriarchal cultures, deepening generational inequities. Over half Asia's elderly population are women, many enduring economic marginalization - trends driving the feminization of elderly poverty. Reliance on adult children for care perpetuates gender bias: sons remain preferred caregivers. Vietnam data shows most elderly co-reside with married sons. India reports 79% living with sons versus 39% with daughters. Thailand's figures stand at 29% with sons and 32% with daughters. China lags significantly: only 4.8% of fathers and 6.46% of mothers live with daughters. 'Thailand’s aging society, lacking historical son-selective practices, demonstrates daughters’ caregiving equality,' explained lead author Prof. M. Niaz Asadullah. Daughter-cohabitation improves happiness through: better health outcomes for elderly women, reduced loneliness across genders, decreased anxiety when daughters have strong family ties or higher education, and financial stability when daughters attain university education. 'Investments in girls' education boost elderly welfare and amplify demographic opportunities,' concluded the researcher.
translated_content: Monasas Malajas universitātes biznesa skolas pētnieki brīdin par to, ka tradicionālais dēļu prioritātes uzskats var paplašināt dzimuma netaisnīgības Aizjumtajās valstīs, kurās vecāku populācija pieauga. Viņu pētījums „Vecuma laikā priekība: māsu nozīme”, publicēts revistā „Journal of Happiness Studies”, pierāda, ka māsu kopdzīvošana nodrošina labāku veselības novērtējumu un emocionālu stabilitāti. Līdz 2030. gada Aizjumtajā pasaules daļā būs vislielākā vecāku grupa, bet vecākā sieviešu stāvoklis kā 'slēpni' turpinās, veicinot jaunus paaudžu starpniecības problēmas. Vairāk nekā puse Aizjumtās reģiona vecākajiem ir sievietes, kuras cieš no ekonomiskām un sociālajām ierobežojumiem, kas veicina vecuma sieviešu pauprības fenomenu. Kad vecāki atrodas bērnu mājās, dēļu prioritāte turpina izraisīt diskrimināciju: dēliem tiek uztverti kā galvenie aprūpes sniedzēji. Vjetnamā lielākā daļa vecākiem dzīvo ar viedējiem dēliem. Indijā 79% vecāku dzīvo ar dēliem, pretī 39% ar māsām. Talonā procenti ir 29% ar dēliem un 32% ar māsām. Ķīnā atšķirība ir liela: tikai 4,8% tēvi un 6,46% mātes dzīvo ar māsām. 'Talonas piemērs, kur nav izplatītas dzimuma izvēles, liecina, ka māsas var būt līdzvērtīgas aprūces sniedzējas', teica pētniecis. Kopdzīvošana ar māsām ir saistīta ar: sieviešu veselības uzlabošanos, abu dzimumu vienatnes samazināšanos, emocionālo stabilitāti ar labām attiecībām vai augstāku izglītību, ekonomisko labklājību, ja māsa ir izglītotāka. 'Politikas, kas veicina sieviešu izglītību, uzlabos vecāku veselību un palīdzēs izmantot demogrāfiskos labumus', uzsvēra pētnieks.

article_content: The family of the man shot dead in full view of his young wife during a violent carjacking at an upscale New Jersey mall on Sunday night demanded the death penalty for his nephew's killers. Dustin Friedland, a 30-year-old lawyer from Hoboken, New Jersey, and his wife Jamie Schare Friedland, 27, were returning to their Range Rover in the parking lot at The Mall At Short Hills when he was fatally shot in the head. Attackers fled in the $80,000 vehicle. Jamie's uncle, Mark Schare, stated Dustin would have surrendered the keys to avoid conflict. Police reports contradict this, indicating a struggle occurred before the shooting. Friedland opened the car door for his wife, then faced attackers upon attempting to enter. A physical struggle ensued with gunfire; the wife was forced out at gunpoint. The Range Rover was later recovered in Newark. Schare expressed anger, stating the killer 'doesn't deserve to breathe.' The couple planned to start a family. Authorities linked the suspects to a regional stolen-car ring. The mall temporarily locked down during the investigation.

article_content: Stephen Rakes, 59, was found deceased on a remote trail in Lincoln, Massachusetts, shortly after being dismissed as a witness in the James 'Whitey' Bulger trial. While police first suspected suicide, an inconclusive autopsy prompted further investigation. Toxicology results pending could take weeks. Rakes had planned to testify that Bulger's gang threatened his daughter to seize his South Boston liquor store in 1984. Though relieved to finally confront Bulger, his removal from the witness list left him devastated. Friend Steven Davis insists the lack of identification and Rakes' determination to testify point to foul play. Bulger's associate Kevin Weeks countered claims of coercion, asserting Rakes voluntarily sold the store. This contradiction underscores unresolved tensions in Bulger's criminal legacy.

article_content: Scientists state there is insufficient evidence supporting vitamin D supplements to prevent chronic diseases and premature death. A new review analyzing 40 randomized controlled trials concludes that vitamin D supplementation provides little to no reduction in heart attacks, strokes, cancer, or fractures in the general population. Published in The Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology, the study suggests current multi-million-dollar trials are unlikely to change this conclusion. The UK's £700m annual supplement market includes popular multi-vitamins and fish oils containing vitamin D. While low vitamin D levels correlate with diseases like cancer, heart disease, and Alzheimer’s, researchers argue these illnesses may suppress vitamin D production rather than being caused by deficiency. A recent review of 462 studies involving over a million adults found no link between vitamin D deficiency and common illnesses. Dr. Mark Bolland’s team performed futility analyses predicting future trials would not demonstrate meaningful benefits. Hip fracture risks slightly increased in some trials. Vulnerable groups like pregnant/breastfeeding women still require prescribed vitamin D for bone health. Critics note the review excluded bone health benefits, urging universal supplementation despite chronic disease findings.
